concept.title: Fuel Point Analytics API Overview
concept.shortdesc: The Altitude Fuel Point Analytics API enables users to detect and analyze refueling events using Geotab first-party telematics data.

conbody.p: Altitude is enhancing the Stop Analytics module with the addition of Refuel Detection. Leveraging Geotab's first-party telematics, this feature distinguishes refueling events from general stops using fuel signals, dwell time, and POI matching.

This API uses the queryType parameter to retrieve fuel point analytics data. The Fuel Point Analytics API shares its stops infrastructure with the Stop Analytics API, and each queryType is a distinct request.
